notes: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next GSQ-RCO IQ3_S (ISTA DASLab). Sampling is the model file's own recommendation. Speculation tuned on this machine (5 prompts x 2-3 runs, sampled): draft 4 / cutoff 0.8 decodes ~58 tok/s vs ~50 with the engine defaults (3 / 0.5); at temperature 1.0 low-confidence drafts are mostly rejected, so a higher cutoff saves verify work. Slots: 3 since 2026-10-15 (two GPUs): the 2-slot limit came from one card's VRAM; with the layers split over two cards, three agents with 172-180K-token contexts (4 turns x 600 tokens) ran 269 s against 341 s with 2 slots (24.2 vs 21.1 tok/s overall), reads after the first turn 1.0 vs 1.3 s. Draft 6 / cutoff 0.6 re-tested on two GPUs the same day: no gain over 4 / 0.8 at temperature 1.0 or 0.
